idea-plugin.name: TCVN3 Vietnamese Encoding
idea-plugin.description:
Adds the legacy Vietnamese TCVN3 (also known as ABC) encoding to all JetBrains IDEs. After installing, "TCVN3" appears in the encoding dropdown (status bar / File Encoding settings) and works for file open / save / Find in Files like any built-in charset.

Registered via the standard Java SPI (java.nio.charset.spi.CharsetProvider) - no IDE files patched, no monkey-patching, just a properly-registered java.nio.charset.Charset.

Round-trip safe: non-TCVN3 bytes (e.g. GBK Chinese filenames inside game data files) decode into the Unicode Private Use Area and re-encode byte-identical, so saving never corrupts mixed-encoding files.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 1.0.5 - Fix for JDK 25: cache1/cache2 on java.nio.charset.Charset are now Object[] (rotating pair arrays), not Map. The v1.0.4 cache patching never matched a Map field and the charset stayed unresolvable. v1.0.5 changes strategy: it wraps the final-static Charset.standardProvider with a delegating CharsetProvider via sun.misc.Unsafe. Charset.forName and Charset.availableCharsets both consult standardProvider, so TCVN3 now resolves and shows up in the IDE encoding picker automatically.
  • 1.0.4 - Fix: preload="notAwait" is not a valid value ("Unknown preload mode value" SEVERE log). Valid values per IntelliJ source are await, true, notHeadless, false. Switched to preload="true" so the bootstrap service actually instantiates on plugin load.
  • 1.0.3 - Fix for IDE 2026.1 / JBR 25:
    • preload="await" is rejected for non-core services ("must be used only for core services"). Switched to preload="notAwait" which IDE accepts.
    • JDK 25 renamed Charset cache fields. Bootstrap now scans every static Map<String, Charset> field on Charset instead of hard-coding cache1/cache2.
    • EncodingManagerImpl.setFavorites(Collection) is gone in 2026.1. Bootstrap now walks fields on EncodingManagerImpl to find any mutable Collection<Charset> and adds TCVN3 to it.
    • Added explicit Tools | Reload File with TCVN3 Encoding action as a guaranteed fallback - works even when the IDE internals change and the bootstrap can't patch them.
  • 1.0.2 - Fix: bootstrap was registered via ApplicationInitializedListener, which fires only at IDE startup. Users who installed v1.0.1 dynamically (without restart) saw the listener miss its window and the charset never reached the picker. Now wired as an application service with preload=await so it runs on both cold start and dynamic plugin load.
  • 1.0.1 - Fix: TCVN3 was not appearing in the encoding picker on fresh installs because the standard Java charset SPI cannot see plugin classloader resources. Now bootstrapped at IDE init: TCVN3 is pushed into Charset's internal cache and added to EncodingManager favorites.
  • 1.0.0 - Initial release. Registers the TCVN3 charset for the entire IntelliJ Platform via Java SPI. Mirrors the codec used by vs-code-tcvn3-customize.

action.description: Reload the current file as TCVN3 (Vietnamese ABC) regardless of the IDE's encoding picker.
